package knowledgeidentity

import (
	"fmt"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

const maxCourseLessonBindings = 1000

// ResolveCourseLessonBindings is the internal, read-only source-key resolver
// used by services that store course lesson references.
type ResolveCourseLessonBindings struct {
	Bindings repository.KnowledgeIdentityRepository
}

func (uc ResolveCourseLessonBindings) Handle(ctx repository.Context, refs []domain.CourseLessonSourceBinding) ([]domain.ResolvedCourseLessonBinding, error) {
	if uc.Bindings == nil || len(refs) == 0 || len(refs) > maxCourseLessonBindings {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	normalized := make([]domain.CourseLessonSourceBinding, 0, len(refs))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(refs))
	for _, ref := range refs {
		courseKey, err := domain.NormalizeContentSourceKey(ref.CourseSourceKey)
		if err != nil || courseKey == "" {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		lessonKey, err := domain.NormalizeContentSourceKey(ref.LessonSourceKey)
		if err != nil || lessonKey == "" {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		key := courseKey + "\x00" + lessonKey
		if _, duplicate := seen[key]; duplicate {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: duplicate course/lesson source binding", domain.ErrValidation)
		}
		seen[key] = struct{}{}
		normalized = append(normalized, domain.CourseLessonSourceBinding{
			CourseSourceKey: courseKey,
			LessonSourceKey: lessonKey,
		})
	}
	return uc.Bindings.ResolveCourseLessonBindings(ctx, normalized)
}
